data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a release on prior accident years in 2022: a net surplus of GBP 7.257m relating to the reassessment of claims for prior years (primarily 2019 and earlier), driven by benign claims experience and COVID-19 related reserve releases. This release equates to approximately a 16.2% reduction relative to the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 44.694m. The business continued to be affected in 2022 by heightened catastrophe activity (notably US Tornadoes, Hurricane Ian and Winter Storm Elliot) which influenced current year claims but the prior-year reserve reassessment produced a net favourable impact.
raw_causal_phrases: a surplus of GBP 7,257,000 (2021: surplus of GBP 1,983,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

The 2020 underwriting year of account benefitted from favourable reserve releases on the 2019 and prior years of account during 2022, driven by benign claims experience, coupled with Covid-19 reserve releases.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (gross change in 'insurance liabilities') is not explicitly stated in the available notes. The report explicitly states a net surplus of GBP 7.257m on prior accident years (net of reinsurance) which has been used as the quantified prior year development (NET of reinsurance) because no clear single gross prior-year movement figure was provided. A gross claims development triangle is present but extracting an unambiguous aggregate gross prior-year movement from the ragged printed triangle proved uncertain; therefore the net figure has been used as last-resort fallback and this is flagged here. Gross premium mix by regulatory class was not provided; the syndicate writes only reinsurance so a single 'Reinsurance' line is used.

_claims_triangle.type_confidence_note: Triangle is present in the report in gross and net form (page 32). The printed table is ragged by underwriting year; the development rows above capture the values as printed. Some terminal columns correspond to cumulative 'paid' cells in the print; blanks are represented as null.
